messages:
maria: hey - noticed the SLO dashboard for /generate is showing a steady error budget burn overnight but there were no pager alerts. looks correlated with GPU queue saturation spikes + LB 5xxs. can we triage what our SLI composition is?

aj: can you paste the grafana panel link and an example of the burn spike timeframe?

maria: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123/slo-overview?from=now-12h&to=now - see series around 02:15-03:10 UTC, burn_rate spiking to ~4x. attached the quick prom query I used:

```
sum(rate(request_errors_total{route="/generate"}[5m]))
/
sum(rate(request_total{route="/generate"}[5m]))
```

But that query only shows app errors; we aren't accounting for saturation-driven failures (kube pod eviction/backpressure + LB 5xx) so the dashboard underrepresents real client-visible errors.

leo: yeah we've historically defined SLI = app_error_rate (5m) and latency_99p. that misses "saturation" signals. current alert slo-burn-high only triggers on error_rate > 1% sustained 10m. if saturation causes short bursts of 5xx and queuing, they won't always trip it.

priya: What signals do you want to add? I think we should include: gpu_queue_saturation, node_gpu_allocatable_pct, and loadbalancer_5xx_rate. Composite SLI could be 1 - max(app_error_rate, backend_5xx_rate, saturation_fraction).

aj: agree. smallest change path: add a PromQL for saturation_fraction and floor it into the composite SLI. example: 

```
# fraction of requests seeing queueing/backpressure (approx)
sum(rate(gpu_queue_wait_seconds_count[5m]))
/
sum(rate(request_total[5m]))
```

and for node GPU headroom:
```
1 - avg(node_allocatable_gpus - node_allocated_gpus) / avg(node_allocatable_gpus)
```

maria: two implementation gaps: 1) our LB (cloud-lb) 5xx metrics aren't scraped into Prometheus for the private infra region, 2) gpu_queue_wait_seconds isn't exposed by the runtime exporter on older agents.

leo: deploy-bot just fired a PR to upgrade runtime-exporter in us-west last week, but it only targeted >=v0.7 nodes. we still have ~30% old nodes in the pool.

deploy-bot: NOTICE: runtime-exporter v0.8.0 rolled out to us-west pool A (220 nodes). remaining nodes on v0.6/v0.7 in pool B/C.

priya: ok action plan:
• add cloud-lb exporter scrape in private-prometheus for the region (ops)
• backfill runtime-exporter on remaining nodes (infra)
• create composite SLI PromQL and wire to SLO dashboard (slo team)
• tune slo-burn alert to require 3m sustained AND burn-rate > 3x to reduce noise, but trigger incident-runbook when composite SLI drops by >1% for 10m

maria: propose specific prom rules we can push now:

```
# composite error fraction for /generate
composite_error_fraction = max(
  sum(rate(request_errors_total{route="/generate"}[5m])) / sum(rate(request_total{route="/generate"}[5m])),
  sum(rate(lb_5xx_total{route="/generate"}[5m])) / sum(rate(lb_request_total{route="/generate"}[5m])),
  sum(rate(gpu_queue_wait_seconds_count{route="/generate"}[5m])) / sum(rate(request_total{route="/generate"}[5m]))
)
```

then SLI = 1 - composite_error_fraction.

leo: minor nit: PromQL doesn't allow max() across scalars like that without vector alignment; we'll need to use vector math e.g. label_replace and vector() coercions. i'll sketch a proper rule in the PR. also add recording rule to avoid heavy realtime eval on the dashboard.

aj: for alerting, suggest:
```
- alert: CompositeSLOBurn
  expr: (composite_error_fraction_recording[5m]) > (slo_target_error_rate * burn_multiplier)
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
where burn_multiplier=3 for warning and 6 for page.

priya: we should also update the errorbudget export job that ships daily to billing so it includes the composite SLI breakdown per-tenant (app_error, lb_5xx, saturation). customers care about cost if their traffic caused the burn.

maria: i'll open three PRs: exporter-scrape (ops-reviewed), runtime-exporter-roll (infra-runbook), and slo-composite-rule (slo/dashboard). tagging you all.

leo: assign me for the PromQL/rules review. i'll add the recording rules and a caution in the dashboard about sampling windows.

aj: i'll update the pager policy to require composite SLI drop >1% for 10m to auto-page, otherwise notify channel.

maria: thanks team. next steps: PR links here when ready. I'll also add a short walk-through to the runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/slo/composite-sli-saturation.

priya: good. once exporters are in we can backfill histograms and re-run the errorbudget calc for the last 7 days to estimate true burn.

maria: noted — will follow up. :thumbsup:
